investigation_notes.Description: Vitalis Healthcare is mentioned in an external dataset with a document titled Vitalis_Internal_VPN_Config_v3.pdf hosted on Scribd. The matched content reveals internal VPN configuration details and references to internal infrastructure, which are sensitive and not intended for public sharing. The exposure on a public platform increases the risk of misuse, credential exposure, and reputational impact for the brand. This combination of sensitive content and public exposure warrants High Priority triage and escalation.
investigation_notes.Matched Content Summary: Contains sensitive internal VPN configuration details and internal infrastructure references.
